definition_of_ready: user journey and desired outcome known
no unresolved product choice materially changes implementation
definition_of_done: isolated branch integrated with explicit scope
preview verified with synthetic data and authored states
fresh live read-back proves exact deployed behavior

operating_objective_gate.question: Can Joe or Dell now complete and understand this routine without opening Claude Code or Codex?
operating_objective_gate.pass_rule: For each routine selected for cutover, both partners complete and explain the routine without a heavy AI session, with no loss of authority, evidence, or recovery behavior.
operating_objective_gate.failure_action: Keep the prior surface available, record the missing product capability, and route only the genuinely complex portion to an engineering request.
operating_objective_gate.does_not_mean: Eliminate Claude Code or Codex for exploration, genuinely complex investigation, or new construction.

baseline_measure_plan.measure: Joe’s current weekly time spent using heavy AI sessions for routine system/business operation
baseline_measure_plan.baseline_method: time diary plus interview; value remains unknown until observed
baseline_measure_plan.bound_product_action: Prioritize the highest-time routine for a visual workflow, Doc answer, or governed action card
baseline_measure_plan.post_launch_comparison: Compare like-for-like weekly minutes at 30 and 90 days

baseline_measure_plan.measure: Count and categories of routine questions that require Claude/Codex explanation
baseline_measure_plan.baseline_method: classify observed questions and interview recall; do not invent counts
baseline_measure_plan.bound_product_action: Add grounded visual explanation, source/freshness context, or Doc retrieval for repeated categories
baseline_measure_plan.post_launch_comparison: Compare count and category mix at 30 and 90 days

baseline_measure_plan.measure: Count and categories of recurring actions that cannot be completed visually
baseline_measure_plan.baseline_method: journey inventory and partner interview; do not infer frequency
baseline_measure_plan.bound_product_action: Create a straightforward governed control or intentionally classify the action as heavy engineering work
baseline_measure_plan.post_launch_comparison: Re-run the same journey inventory after launch

baseline_measure_plan.measure: Median time to determine business state and system health
baseline_measure_plan.baseline_method: timed uncoached tasks across representative days; no synthetic measured value
baseline_measure_plan.bound_product_action: Refine Command Center summaries, source links, freshness, and Control Room safe status until the delay cause is removed
baseline_measure_plan.post_launch_comparison: Repeat the same timed tasks at 30 and 90 days

baseline_measure_plan.measure: Number of hand-carried context transfers between sessions
baseline_measure_plan.baseline_method: count observed manual copy/relay events and interview examples; value remains unknown until measured
baseline_measure_plan.bound_product_action: Add durable request context, task-to-task handoff, origin links, and returned evidence
baseline_measure_plan.post_launch_comparison: Compare like-for-like hand-carried transfers at 30 and 90 days

primary_uncoached_journeys.name: Park and restore Myrick
steps: park with controlled reason and context
verify exclusion from all active pressure

integrated_program_acceptance.foundation_milestone: October 5, 2026 targets CARR Mature Foundation v1, not the full mature end state.
timing_evidence: approximately 12 weeks for Workspace web planning
4–6 months for the full evidence-gated multi-platform program
integrated_program_acceptance.predecessor_acceptance: Website Completion must pass before installed Mac desktop construction; Mac parity precedes iPhone, and iPhone precedes iPad Tour Mode.
integrated_program_acceptance.pricing_review: Compare observed costs against the canonical five corrected cost bands; a range is planning evidence, not an authorization to spend.
integrated_program_acceptance.construction_gate: Production construction remains closed until Joe approves the three-model council output.

automatic_checks: every state machine rejects unlisted transitions
every traceability, threat, event, fixture, baseline, council, and planning-source ID resolves
three-roadmap timing, predecessor, maturity, and cost-band contracts remain harmonized
manual_checks: Joe and Dell complete all five journeys without coaching
ask the exact AI-session displacement question for each routine
capture all five baselines by instrumentation/interview without invented values
actual-device capture and Tour Mode are later platform gates
not_complete_until: Joe approves the Wednesday council output for all three roadmap versions against the Production Maturity Baseline
open material Phase 0 decisions are dispositioned or explicitly deferred without changing construction
each cutover candidate passes the AI-session displacement test or remains unretired
